name: Nobody approves or recommends work of their own party (a setting, off by default)
summary: An installation setting of the web service, off by default: --approval-by-another-party on http_service.py, or approval_by_another_party: true in the office service configuration. Off, every review rule is what it was. On, one party is an account, every agent that account made and every worker credential it issued (Service.actor_parties): approve is refused with 403 and a sentence that says what to do when the approver's party is that of the contribution's author or the task's assignee, a superuser included for their own party's work; recommend, the review queue, My work and the brief count by the same parties. Work under a worker credential is traced by the credential whose actor namespace holds the name, in that project; where two issuers held one name, the credential alive when the contribution was written decides, else both count. GET /v1/projects/{id}/setup carries rules.approval_by_another_party and the set-up page says whether it is on.
